candidate.selection_reason: node.type (potentially attacker-controlled) -> safe hasOwnProperty check -> prevents execution of unregistered node types
candidate.source_summary: node.type is a fixed string property defined on Node subclasses (e.g., 'AccessorNode', 'ArrayNode') during registration. Node types are registered via compileFunctions map using register() function.
candidate.sink_summary: If check passes: compileFunctions[node.type] is called with (node, defs, args) to generate JavaScript code. If check fails but node._compile exists: node._compile(defs, args) is called directly (security risk per TODO).
candidate.guard_summary: hasOwnProperty check prevents execution of unregistered node types. Registration is controlled internally via fixed type strings. Fallback to node._compile exists but is marked as security risk.
candidate.risk_pattern: Type-based dispatch with allowlist validation. The hasOwnProperty check ensures only pre-registered node types can execute their compile functions, preventing arbitrary code execution via malicious node types.
candidate.context_summary: Security check added to prevent execution of unregistered node types. Compile function registry ensures only known safe node types can generate code. Fallback path exists for CustomNodes but is explicitly marked as security risk.
unresolved_facts: Whether external input can influence node.type value
Whether CustomNode _compile fallback can be exploited
How node objects are constructed from user input

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions
target_cwe.description: The product does not check or incorrectly checks for unusual or exceptional conditions that are not expected to occur frequently during day to day operation of the product.
remediation_steps: Implement proper error handling and logging without information disclosure
